title: CopilotKit releases OpenDuet, a proactive agent you host yourself
friendlyTitle: CopilotKit has released OpenDuet, a proactive agent you can host yourself
summary: CopilotKit released OpenDuet on 27 October, an open-source template for an agent that sends a morning brief, keeps working after you close the app, and asks before it sends a message, pays, or deletes anything. It is meant to run on your own infrastructure, with any model, through the AG-UI protocol. A connected computer and browser can keep going while the laptop is off. The post calls it an early, single-owner starting point.
friendlySummary: CopilotKit released OpenDuet on 27 October. It is an open-source template for an agent that sends a short morning brief, keeps working after you close the app, and asks before it sends a message, pays, or deletes anything. You are meant to run it on your own servers, with any model, using the AG-UI protocol. A connected computer and browser can keep going while your laptop is off. The post calls it an early starting point for one owner.
whyItMatters: Hosted coworkers already start tasks and check in. OpenDuet is the version you can read and change, and the approval step is in the template. You allow once, always allow, or refuse. It is not a company rollout. The part worth copying, even if you never run this repo, is the check before a send, a payment, or a delete.
